# TPC-Havoc Q4_v9

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select distinct
    o_orderpriority,
    count(*) over (partition by o_orderpriority) as order_count
from
    orders
where
    o_orderdate >= date '1993-07-01'
    and o_orderdate < date '1993-07-01' + interval '3' month
    and exists (
        select *
        from lineitem
        where l_orderkey = o_orderkey
          and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
    )
order by
    o_orderpriority
```
